paite: Manasseh suante tantuam hiaite ahi. Manasseh Joseph tapa masa ahi a, Gilead pa, Manasseh tapa masa Makir galhat ahih ziak in Gilead leh Bashan gam atang hi.
heading: Tumlam Manasseh
english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

paite: Manasseh suan dang tengteng a ding in a-inkuan uh dungzui in tantuam leng a-om hi. Abiezer suante a ding, Helek suante a ding, Shekem suante a ding, Hepher suante a ding leh Shemida suante a ding. Huaite a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Joseph tapa Manasseh suan pasalte ahi uhi.
english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

paite: Manasseh tapa Makir, huai tapa Gilead, huai tapa Hepher, huai tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lou in tanu ngen anei hi. Atanute min Mahlah, Noah, Hoglai, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi.
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Siampu Eleazar ma ah leh Nun tapa Joshua ma ah leh miliante ma ah ahoh ua, "Ka unaute uh lak a tantuam hon pe sam ding in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apia hi," chi in agen uhi. TOUPA thupiak bang in apa uh unaute lak ah tantuam ape samta hi.
english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of Yahweh he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

paite: Jordan gal ah Gilead leh Bashan gam sim louh in, Manasseh tantuam ding in mun sawm apuk a;
english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

paite: Manasseh tanute'n atapate uh lak ah tantuam aneih sam ziak uh ahi. Gilead gam bel Manasseh tapa dangte'n atang uhi.
english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

paite: Manasseh gamgi Shekem suahlam a om Asher a pan Mikmethath pha in ahi a; taklam pang ah En-tappuah mite tenna pha in apai hi.
english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

paite: Tappuah gam Manasseh a ahi a; himahleh Manasseh gamgi chin a Tappuah ahihleh Ephraim suante a ahi.
english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

paite: Gamgi kan in luita simlam pang ah apaisuk a, Ephraim suante gamgi asun hi. Ephraim suante khopite khenkhat Manasseh suante khopite lak ah a-om hi. Himahleh Manasseh suante gamgi bel Kanah kuam mallam pang ah apai a, tuipi ah atawp hi.
english: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

paite: Simlam pang Ephraim a ahi a, mallam pang pen Manasseh a ahi. Tuipi a gamgi ahi. Mallam ah Asher pha in ahi a, suahlam ah Issakar pha in ahitou hi.
english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

paite: Issakar leh Asher gam ah Manasseh in Beth-shean leh akim a khuate, Ibleam leh akim a khuate, Dor a tengte leh akim a khuate, Endor a tengte leh akim a khuate, Taanak a tengte leh akim a khuate, leh Meggiddo a tengte leh akim a khuate zou in, kho seh thum anei uhi.
english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

paite: Kanaan mite'n huai gam luah asawm teitei ziak un, Manasseh suante'n huai khopi a tengte adelhkhe zou kei uhi.
english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante ahong hat hiaihiai un, Kanaante nasem a goih ding in a-omsak ua, adelhkhe siang vek kei uhi.
english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

paite: Joseph suante'n Joshua kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia gouluah ding tantuam seh khat, tan khat kia na hon piak tuam, TOUPA'N lah tutan in hon nak vualzawl mahmah ngal a?" achi uhi.
heading: Ephraim Leh Tumlam Manasseh In Gam Angetbeh Uh
english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because Yahweh has blessed us so far?”

paite: Joshua in akiang uah, "Tam na hih uleh, Perizte leh miliante gammang na tenna ding un va vat un. Ephraim tanggam pen nou a dia aneu luatleh," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

paite: Joseph suante'n, "Tanggam kou a ding in ahun kei. Phaigam a teng Kanaan tengteng, Beth-shean leh akhopi a tengte leh Jezreel phaizang a tengte'n sik kangtalai anei chiat tuamse uh," achi uhi.
english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

paite: Joshua in Joseph inkuante, Ephraim leh Manasseh suante kiang ah, "Na tam mahmah ua, hat leng na hat ua; tan khat kia na nei kei ding uh.
english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

paite: 'Tanggam teng nou a ding ahi lai ding hi. Gammang hitaleh, na vat ding ua, agam chiang tengteng nou a ahi ding.' Kanaante'n sik kangtalaite nei in, hat tawk le uh leng, na hawlkhe zou ding uh," achi hi.
english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”
